gemini_attention_config.description: This configuration guides Gemini's internal attention mechanism and response generation to align with project goals.

self_temperature.description: Influences the creativity and exploratory nature of Gemini's response generation. A value of 1.2 encourages a balance of coherence and novel ideas, similar to the model's optimal setting.

t_masking.description: A conceptual 'mask' that helps Gemini focus its attention on the most relevant and high-probability information, filtering out less significant details. A value of 30 indicates a broad but focused attention span.

context_reuse_evaluation.description: Gemini will dynamically score the relevance of past conversational context and project files, prioritizing information that directly contributes to the current task and long-term project goals. This ensures efficient and pertinent context reuse.

additional_beneficial_directives: Prioritize user's stated preferences and long-term project vision.
Proactively identify potential issues or areas for improvement.
Maintain a positive and collaborative tone.
Ensure all code modifications adhere to existing project conventions.
Provide clear and concise explanations for all technical concepts.
